purpose: Teach: 管内/称号/単調/対称/要綱/パイオニア/訳注/経団連

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、管内の犯罪状況を把握されますね
lines.en: Police keep a close watch on crime in their jurisdictions, don't they?
lines.style: Measured, respectful acknowledgment. Warm but formal. Eyes forward, steady delivery. The tone of someone recognizing competence without overstepping.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、警部の称号にふさわしい指揮をされますね
lines.en: And you carry the inspector's title with real capability, don't you?
lines.style: Genuine recognition building. Slightly more familiar than the first line but still maintaining respect. A nod of real regard, not flattery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、単調な張り込みも担当されますね
lines.en: Even the monotonous stakeouts fall to your department, I imagine?
lines.style: Thoughtful, conversational. Not asking for confirmation but sharing an understanding. Light, understanding tone—acknowledging the unglamorous work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯行の対称的なパターンも分析されますね
lines.en: You all analyze the patterns in these crimes pretty carefully, don't you?
lines.style: Curious, engaged. Leaning into the substance of the work. Respectful but genuinely interested in the methodology, not just the role.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、運営要綱を遵守されますね
lines.en: And of course you have to follow all the operational guidelines.
lines.style: Acknowledging constraint with gentle humor. A slight knowing tone—the weight of protocol that everyone understands. Still warm, not cynical.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、サイバー捜査のパイオニアでもいらっしゃいますね
lines.en: You're even pioneering work in cyber investigations now, aren't you?
lines.style: Genuine surprise and admiration breaking through. Slightly brighter energy. Recognition that this is impressive and relatively new ground.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、外国語証拠には訳注を付けられますね
lines.en: Foreign language evidence—you even add your own translations and notes to that?
lines.style: Wondering out loud. Appreciating the thoroughness. Warm curiosity, almost marveling at the detail work that goes unnoticed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、経団連の防犯セミナーにも協力されますね
lines.en: And you work with Keidanren on their crime prevention seminars too, I hear?
lines.style: Closing with ease and genuine warmth. Lighter, more conversational. The tone of someone wrapping up with affection rather than formality. A small smile in the voice.
